description: Rename a project, move it to another client, or change its rate or billable flag. Only the fields you pass change.

billable.description: Whether the time goes on invoices

client.description: Move the project to this client

hourly_rate.description: New amount per hour in the client's currency (its own, else the account's), e.g. 85 or 62.5

project.description: Project id, or "Client / Project" (just the project name works when it is unique)

name: update_project
title: Edit a project
